canonical_program.rule: Per-row dataset_revision and primary_metric are read from this canonical program file, not from secondary reports.

host_contract_observed.evidence_note: The PreemptionCandidate definition on main carries num_output_tokens, max_tokens and builtin_victim_id but no predicted_length field. DlaVictimPolicy._any_prediction() therefore returns False for every context and select_victim() abstains, which is bit-identical to upstream scheduling.
host_contract_observed.consequence: Two independent gates fail before any workload question: the manifest version range excludes the current host source line, and the required vllm.predicted-length protocol is not supplied by the host.

profile.model_revision_note: No DLA run exists against this model. A revision must be frozen by whichever measured run is eventually claimed; no value is inferred here.
profile.mechanism: Decode-length-aware preemption victim selection in the vLLM scheduler process
profile.implementation: python_module dla.policy:DlaVictimPolicy (status active, no entry-point auto-registration)
profile.predictor_validated_workload: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (EGTP head reproduced on ForeLen); no Qwen3.5-35B-A3B predictor is validated
profile.activation_rule: DLA can change a decision only when all three hold: (1) the host exposes predicted_length on preemption candidates, (2) at least one candidate carries a prediction, and (3) the KV block pool is full so the scheduler actually preempts. Condition (3) requires at least two concurrently running requests. Every primary-dataset protocol below is single-concurrency, so condition (3) never holds. Additionally the deployed host fails (1) and (2) outright.
profile.non_metrics: Task accuracy and task resolution rate are not DLA metrics and cannot demonstrate this mechanism.

datasets.primary_metric: Task accuracy under a pinned evaluator
datasets.reason: Task-quality evaluation submits one request at a time. The frozen reference five-shot prompts are 898-2910 tokens, so even the longest single prompt is far from saturating a 16 GiB-per-card KV pool. With one active request the scheduler never has to preempt, so the victim-selection decision DLA changes is never reached. The historical 200-prompt artifact is serving telemetry and is not task accuracy.
datasets.owner: @xiehanlong834-gif (MOD); benchmark #254 maintainers (task manifest and scorer contract)
datasets.next_step: Do not report a DLA result here. If a serving-side claim is ever wanted, keep the task-quality protocol unchanged and construct a separate concurrent workload that saturates the KV pool, then report JCT and preemption counts as serving evidence, not accuracy.

datasets.primary_metric: Accuracy under the pinned HLE-Verified evaluator
datasets.reason: Single-request serial evaluation. The 2500-row source includes a 668-question Gold subset with 93 image questions; whatever subset is chosen, one question is submitted at a time, so no concurrent KV pressure and no preemption exists for DLA to act on. The dataset-side licence, scope and judge gaps are tracked separately under #254 and are not a DLA mechanism question.
datasets.owner: @xiehanlong834-gif (MOD); benchmark #254 maintainers (rights, subset and evaluator contract)
datasets.next_step: Keep the row not-exercised regardless of how the rights and judge gates close; they do not create a concurrent workload. A DLA claim would require a separate serving workload with its own frozen preemption evidence.

datasets.primary_metric: Resolved task rate in isolated regrading
datasets.reason: Agentic but strictly serial: the archived single trajectory runs one agent in one container, issuing 79 model replies before submitting. Only one request is ever active, so even a 37,370-token turn competes with nothing and cannot cause preemption. Multi-turn agent behaviour raises context length, not concurrency.
datasets.owner: @xiehanlong834-gif (MOD); benchmark #254 maintainers (sandbox, agent and regrader contract)
datasets.next_step: Do not attribute agent turn count or context length to DLA benefit. A DLA measurement would need several concurrent agents sharing one KV pool, which the frozen protocol explicitly forbids.

datasets.reason: Single-question, problem-only and thinking-disabled rendering; 100 Olympiad and 60 Research tasks are evaluated track by track, one request at a time. No concurrent occupancy exists, so the scheduler never preempts and DLA abstains structurally rather than by configuration.
datasets.next_step: Keep both tracks separate and keep this row not-exercised. The pending track-specific graders are a dataset-contract blocker under #254, not a DLA activation path.

datasets.reason: The candidate Harbor protocol pins one trial per task and one concurrent trial, with 100 turns and a 32K context. Concurrency is therefore exactly one by contract, so preemption cannot occur and the DLA decision point is unreachable.
datasets.owner: @xiehanlong834-gif (MOD); benchmark #254 maintainers (Harbor image, agent and verifier contract)
datasets.next_step: Do not raise concurrency to manufacture a DLA effect; that would change the pinned protocol. Any DLA evidence must come from a separately declared serving workload.

boundaries.offline_simulation_is_not_evidence: The repository README records an offline block-pool simulation (BurstGPT 10k requests, vLLM LIFO baseline, 3 seeds) with JCT p50 -23%, preemptions -28% and wasted prefill tokens -56%. That is mechanism-side offline evidence. It is not a primary-dataset measurement, not a served result and not task quality, and must not be cited as any row's outcome.
boundaries.no_activation_claim: Implementation, unit tests and successful discovery do not prove activation in a real preemption case. No activation is claimed here.
boundaries.cross_dataset_gaps_stay_separate: Four of the five rows carry dataset-side contract blockers under #254 (licence, judge, sandbox, images). This report answers only whether DLA can be activated on each dataset and does not restate or resolve those blockers.
boundaries.no_readiness_change: No global readiness, official leaderboard cell or MOD qualification changes because of this report.
